correctness.rationale: The proof covers every parameter range. Star colorings reduce to exact class-size capacities; two-color bicliques satisfy a rigid row/column-sum equation forcing K_{2,2r}; three-color constructions are explicit outside two genuine four-color obstructions; K_{3,4} is ruled out by the color-subgraph parity argument and K_{4,5} by a six-edge bound for each color class. The packaged verifier independently replays the exceptional finite checks and broad constructive ranges.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact classification for the canonical complete-bipartite family of a recently introduced invariant. It resolves all low-minimum-degree bicliques not controlled by the general delta-at-least-five theorem, identifies an infinite exact two-color parity family, and isolates the complete list of four-color exceptions.
